messages:
alex: Quick coordination — proposing a launch-gate orchestration sync for the upcoming cut. Proposed slot: Wed 2026-06-02 21:00 UTC (14:00 PT). Need to confirm owners, blockers, and a compact agenda. Poll: https://rwd.in/poll/launch-gate Doc: https://rwd.in/docs/launch-gate-draft

Agenda (draft):
```
1) Roll status (high-level) - 5m
2) Canary smoke plan + owners - 10m
3) DB migration window & rollback owner - 10m
4) Infra blockers (coord, kafka, network) - 5m
5) Monitoring, SLO checks & runbooks - 5m
6) Final signoff checklist & next steps - 5m
```

mira: Heads up — 21:00 UTC is doable for EMEA/APAC folks, thanks. APAC prefers earlier but can make it. I'll volunteer to cover monitoring/runbooks.

paul: I can take the canary smoke plan and run the smoke checklist. Would prefer if we keep canary owner list explicit (owner + backup).

jen: I'll take DB migration + rollback plan. One request — please link the migration runbook in the doc (I updated the runbook yesterday).

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example/evt/1923456789 (organizer: alex)

samir: FYI there's a dependent infra change (kafka rolling update) currently tentatively scheduled same day in infra calendar. I'll sync with infra and either move it or flag as blocker. @alex adding as potential blocker.

alex: Thanks — noted infra dependency and added a blocker line in the doc. Everyone please RSVP in the poll if you can make the slot. If you can't, ping here with availability.

mira: RSVP: yes (can do 21:00 UTC)

paul: RSVP: yes. Canary owner: paul, backup: sara. I'll paste the smoke steps below.

jen: RSVP: yes. Rollback owner: jen, backup: lee. Added runbook link: https://rwd.in/runbooks/db-migration-v2

samir: RSVP: tentative until infra confirms, will update by EOD

alex: OK — tentatively locking 21:00 UTC pending infra. Paul, can you drop a one-line smoke checklist here so I can add to the agenda?

paul: Smoke steps (one-line each):
1) deploy canary to pool-a
2) run health check: `./scripts/health_check.sh canary`
3) perf sanity: `loadtest --qps 50 --duration 2m`
4) verify traces + error rate < 0.5%

jen: Rollback plan (one-line): revert image -> previous tag, disable autoscaling, run `db-rollback-lite` if migration-related failure.

alex: Perfect — adding these to the final checklist. Two asks before I finalize: (1) if you have any must-have metrics to check during smoke (latency p50/p95, error rate thresholds, key traces) paste them; (2) if anyone needs a different time window, call it out now.

mira: Monitoring metrics: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, request queue depth < 10.

paul: Adding synthetic query sample: `curl -sS https://api.rwd/test -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` — include as quick sanity.

samir: Infra note: if infra can't move the kafka update, the fallback is to shift our cut by +2h. I'll confirm by EOD.

alex: Thanks — I'll publish final agenda + invite 24h before the meeting. If infra forces shift, will post update here and re-run poll. Appreciate the quick replies :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before meeting (21:00 UTC)
